task.description:
Resolve blocker ISS-SCH01-RV-002 (NFR-02 throughput below threshold) so SCH-01 release gate can pass.

Required outcome:
- Achieve NFR-02 append throughput >= 1000 events/sec in zig build bench under current benchmark contract.
- Keep NFR-01 and NFR-04 passing.
- Preserve SCH-01 functionality and avoid regressions.

Permitted approaches:
- Optimize benchmark harness and/or backend append path performance.
- Tune benchmark setup realism if currently introducing avoidable bottlenecks, but keep contract semantically valid and documented.

Validation before completion:
- zig build exits 0
- zig build test exits 0
- zig build bench exits 0 with NFR_BENCH_SUMMARY PASS

If not fully resolved, return FAILED with precise root cause and concrete next fix path.
acceptance_criteria: NFR-02 threshold passes in benchmark run
Benchmark output remains machine-readable and release-validator compatible

result.summary: Resolved ISS-SCH01-RV-002 by optimizing NFR-02 throughput benchmark write path to avoid implicit per-insert autocommit overhead while preserving benchmark output contract and correctness. Validation results: zig build PASS, zig build test PASS, zig build bench PASS with NFR_BENCH_SUMMARY overall_passed=true and NFR-02 append_throughput_eps=1698.833 (target >=1000).
result.next_action: Route to RELEASE-VALIDATOR to rerun step 05b for SCH-01 release decision.
